name: GRAVEMAW
subtitle: THE ORBITAL DEVOURER
fantasy: A living asteroid that turns swallowed fleets into bone armor.

organs.name: HUNTER EYE
organs.effect: Homing salvos lose their lock and become straight shots.

organs.name: GRAVITY LUNG
organs.effect: Gravity rings slow down and their safe gap widens.

organs.name: BONE FORGE
organs.effect: Bone missile vents crack shut for the rest of the fight.

name: SERAPH-9
subtitle: THE DEAD GOD ENGINE
fantasy: A biomechanical angel-machine whose worship became executable code.

organs.name: PRISM CORTEX
organs.effect: Prism lances lose one reflected beam and telegraph longer.

organs.name: WING REACTOR
organs.effect: One laser wing collapses and leaves a permanent safe flank.

organs.name: HALO CHOIR
organs.effect: The halo barrier fractures and no longer closes completely.

name: ABYSS LEVIATHAN
subtitle: THE RIFT EEL
fantasy: A cosmic eel that swims through ruptures in distance itself.

organs.name: VORTEX STOMACH
organs.effect: Suction waves weaken and leave a larger calm channel.

organs.name: SHOCK GLAND
organs.effect: Electrical arcs stop chaining through nearby hazards.

organs.name: BROOD SAC
organs.effect: Parasite vents seal and no new exterior swarms can spawn.

name: NULL TWIN
subtitle: THE MIRROR ORGANISM
fantasy: A paired lifeform that learns the Diver and grows a weaponized reflection.

organs.name: MEMORY CORTEX
organs.effect: The Twin forgets the equipped weapon and stops copying its shots.

organs.name: ECHO HEART
organs.effect: Echo paths fade; the Twin can no longer replay the last dash.

organs.name: REFLECTION LATTICE
organs.effect: False wounds collapse and the true vulnerable tissue stays visible.
